title: US-Mexico river deal cuts Mexico’s Colorado River share by 250,000 acre-feet for 2 years
summary_full: Mexico's commitment to draw less water from the Colorado River system showcases a proactive approach amid ongoing sustainability challenges. This two-year agreement, lauded by experts for its exemplary binational collaboration, emerged from a series of meetings held by a dedicated commission. It aims to provide essential water stability for users in Mexico as US states continue to navigate their differing priorities.
